title: A non-collinear OPA with the angle from the pump arm
summary: A 1030 nm pulse is doubled in BBO, the 515 nm pump reaches a second BBO crystal through an arm tilted by 4° (2.42° inside the crystal, BBO's magic angle) and amplifies an 800 nm, 10 nJ seed to 14.1 µJ, with an idler of 7.8 µJ leaving at 11.3° and a Manley-Rowe residual of -2e-8.
